name: Zoku: Iranai Ko Game Reset
original_name: 続:いらない子ゲーム reset
source:
Expansion/sequel pack for psycho suspense novel "Iranaiko Game".

Now added is a previously unselectable "one path", an 8,000-word additional short story (main content) and gallery mode + BGM mode by popular request!

Plus, several bonuses like original wallpaper and character icons, the full versions of OP and ED songs and more.
[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE114656.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
心理悬疑小说“Iranaiko Game”的扩展/续集包。

应大众要求，现在增加了之前无法选择的“一条路”、8000字的追加短篇小说（主要内容）以及画廊模式+BGM模式！

另外，还有一些奖励，如原创壁纸和角色图标、OP和ED歌曲的完整版本等等。
[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE114656.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
